sections.content:
Several everyday idiomatic expressions rely on `-lak/-lek`:
- **Nem értelek félre.** = I don't misunderstand you.
- **Nem zavarlak sokáig.** = I won't keep/bother you for long.
- **Kérlek szépen / Kérlek alássan.** = Please / You're welcome / Go right ahead.
- **Isten látja lelkemet, szeretlek.** = God knows my heart, I love you.

items.spanish: Csak két percre jöttem, nem zavarlak sokáig.
items.english: I only came for two minutes, I won't bother you for long.
Please, sit down for a minute!
